messages:
alex: FYI customer (NimbleHealth) wants a per-token cap for the POC — asking $0.0006/token for hosted text gen. Our standard for that model is $0.0012.
maria: Do they have projected monthly usage? need that for deal desk math.
alex: Roughly 15M tokens/mo during POC window (6 weeks) if they ramp. No commit yet, purely usage-based POC.
sam: technical note: their workload is a lot of short completion calls (avg 60 tokens). That penalizes batching.
eric: @maria if we did a temporary override to $0.0006, math below: 15M * $0.0006 = $9k/mo. At our normal rate it'd be $18k/mo. So delta is $9k.
finance_bot: flagged: potential margin impact ~$9k/mo for POC period. Recommend min-charge or reduce window.
maria: two commercial levers: 1) one-time POC discount (timeboxed), 2) apply a min monthly charge, or 3) require a small commit. Which does AE prefer?
alex: They won't sign a commit before product fit. Prefer a timeboxed per-token cap for POC + min monthly floor of $5k to cover fixed costs.
sam: can we enforce rate-limited endpoints to keep costs predictable? we can set burst caps and alerting.
eric: If we accept cap + $5k floor, we push to dealdesk for approval. Need legal checkbox in SOW: POC timeframe and usage cap.
dealdesk: submitting for manual review. Please attach expected usage breakout and a note on why this is strategic.
maria: attaching calc: "Projected tokens by week" and note: >6-week POC, expected 10-20M tokens. Also add a clause: if usage exceeds 120% forecast, we renegotiate.
alex: I'll send the SOW draft and the usage table. Also looping @sam for the rate-limiting config.
sam: will provide config snippet and endpoint names. Example: `x-rate-limit: 250 reqs/min` and `burst: 500` — we'll set KV cache TTL to 30s.
finance_bot: quick approval rule: ad-hoc per-token discounts below 50% of list must be signed off by RevOps + FP&A.
dealdesk: noted. Please ping @eric for RevOps sign-off once pieces are uploaded.
eric: I'll review once SOW + usage table are in. If we see real risk, suggest increasing floor to $7.5k.
alex: trying $5k floor first — that's what fits their budget. If dealdesk asks for $7.5k we can counter with shorter POC window.
maria: next steps: alex upload SOW + usage table; sam upload rate-limit config; eric & dealdesk to review for sign-off. Target response by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
alex: on it. Thanks everyone.
